media:group.media:title: "Chestnuts Roasting on an Open Fire" / "The Christmas Song"
media:group.media:description:
Happy Holidays!
-Video Game Pianist
Special thanks to the following Patrons: LA, DD, Vic Jang, Rob Kovacs, scooge, Akira Kato, & Pablo Nogues!
Biography
“A brilliant pianist” (The Times of London), Martin Leung—known worldwide as the Video Game Pianist—makes our globe a more joyful place. He is one of the first pianists to gain international recognition for performing video game music on the piano, both in concert halls and online. Leung holds piano performance degrees from the Cleveland Institute of Music and the Yale School of Music, and a Doctor of Musical Arts from USC. A pioneer of video game music as a concert art form, he has performed in 16 countries, appeared at major game conventions and venues, collaborated with orchestras, and been featured by The New York Times, Wired, NPR, and in multiple films and documentaries.
